# Hybrid Authentication & Security Checklist: การปรับปรุงระบบพิสูจน์ตัวตนแบบผสมผสาน

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, completeness, and clarity of hybrid authentication, cookie transport, session renewal, and logout requirements.
**Created**: 2026-10-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](file:///Users/chanchai/workshop/CODE/ice-pos-web/specs/009-hybrid-auth-support/spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are credential transmission requirements explicitly specified for all outgoing API requests? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are both HttpOnly Cookie transport and Authorization Header mechanisms defined in functional requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Are server-side logout notification requirements documented with expected session invalidation behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Are local cleanup requirements defined for client-side storage upon logout or expiration? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [ ] CHK005 Is the fallback behavior clearly defined when a refresh token is absent from local storage in cookie-only environments? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the single-flight coordination mechanism specified to prevent race conditions during concurrent 401 responses? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the preserved storage items (branch ID, branch details, cart items) explicitly distinguished from cleared session items? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK008 Are behavior requirements defined when server logout request fails due to network outage or server unresponsiveness? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Are requirements specified for handling repeated or permanent 401 unauthorized errors without infinite retry loops? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Are browser cookie restriction scenarios (cross-origin / third-party cookie blocking) addressed with hybrid fallback? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Are state recovery requirements defined when a page reload occurs during active cashier operations? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Measurability & Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] CHK012 Can the silent refresh requirement of zero UI flicker/interruption be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the 5-second PIN re-login turnaround time objectively measurable under standard test conditions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the 1-second notification display threshold verifiable upon session expiration navigation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Non-Functional & Elderly-Friendly Design Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Are accessibility and Elderly-Friendly requirements specified for session alert dialogs and re-login buttons? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK016 Are touch target dimensions and contrast ratios defined with specific measurable standards (>=48x48px, WCAG 2.1 AA)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001 - CHK016) for easy reference and audit
